entities.summary: Began as Junior Data Analyst at Bridgemark Solutions on January 15th, working in the downtown Portland office on SW 5th Avenue, a mid-size consulting firm with around 200 employees. In February, title was restructured to Data Analyst, and the user was moved to a dedicated client project for MedVantage, a healthcare company. Around March 3rd, Diane Kowalski, the analytics team manager who has been with Bridgemark for seven years, assigned the user ownership of the quarterly reporting deliverable for MedVantage. The user prefers independent problem-solving and references Diane Kowalski frequently. User has a vague aspiration to eventually move toward data engineering as a specialization, though it is not a concrete or planned goal at this time.
